articles.title: It's time for Nvidia to take a page out of Apple's playbook and do more for investors
articles.description: It's time for Nvidia to admit its status as a solid grower and do more for shareholders than it already has.

articles.title: Mastercard’s stock is up 11,000% since its IPO 20 years ago. What comes next?
articles.description: Mastercard is in an elite club. Among S&P 500 components, only Nvidia and Apple shares have performed better over the two-decade span since the card company’s IPO.

articles.title: Huawei plans new smartphone chips this fall as rivalry with Nvidia and Apple heats up
articles.description: Chinese telecom giant Huawei announced Monday a new way of designing chips that improves their capabilities, despite U.S. restrictions on the company.
